snippet.title: NiFe WARS: Battle in Dagon's Lab - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
General Talos and Human Emperor Melek Taus locate the Nemosh laboratory on planet Nemosh in an attempt to rescue General Melrose. They have located the adallium and enter the lab only to meet Commanders Dagon and Sartosis of the Gray alliance ready to battle to protect the command center and their stockpile of NiFe. 
---------------------------------------------------------------
NiFe WARS is a sci-fi anime universe of collectible comics and NFC-authenticated drops. The year is 3022, and humanity is at war with the Grays for control of NiFe — the rarest meta-material in the galaxy. Follow Melcrose, the cyborg heroine hunted across the cosmos by Emperor Temeluchus.
